allow: PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(90\); do { $f = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4200 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $b = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($f -and $b\) { break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline\); "frontend listening: $\([bool]$f\)"; "backend listening: $\([bool]$b\)"; try { "frontend http: " + \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:4200 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20\).StatusCode } catch { "frontend http failed: $_" }; try { "backend http: " + \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000/api/health -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10\).StatusCode } catch { "backend http: $_" })
